heroHeadline: Israeli Strike Kills Newlywed Woman in Arab Salim; Child Dies of Cluster Bomb Wounds in Haboush
heroSubtitle: Near-nightly Israeli strikes and demolitions continued across south Lebanon through late August, killing a newlywed woman in Arab Salim and a child from an unexploded cluster munition in Haboush, as President Aoun vowed the South won't be a 'forgotten region' and Hezbollah's Qassem rejected 'surrender.' The next round of Rome talks is expected in mid-September.
